Name: Writ Entropy
Description: You write a passage describing a blast of eldritch energy and choose a point within 60 feet, causing an otherworldly illusion of an eruption of cosmic power. All creatures in a 15-foot radius surrounding that point must make an Intelligence saving throw, taking 8d6 psychic damage on a failed save. Any creatures who fail also feel slowed by a cold void-like presence hanging over them, and cannot take the Dash action or make more than one weapon attack (regardless of features) on a given turn until the start of your next turn. Creatures who can see through illusions (such as creatures with truesight) automatically succeed their saving throw against this effect.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell at 4th level or higher, the radius of the sphere increases by 5 feet, and the psychic damage increases by 1d6 for every slot level above 3rd.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
